import subprocess,re,json
pat=re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(sk-(?:proj-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|-----BEGIN .*PRIVATE KEY-----)')
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','--','.dip'],text=True).splitlines()
for f in files:
 s=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+f],text=True)
 matches=list(pat.finditer(s))
 if matches:
  print(json.dumps({'file':f,'matches':[{'prefix':m.group()[:7],'length':len(m.group()),'preceding':s[max(0,m.start()-25):m.start()]} for m in matches[:2]]}))
